entries.248df748ca3043b3: The holding company of an independent system integrator that brings together subsidiaries responsible for building systems for social infrastructure such as the public and financial sectors.
entries.a85f49787aaf516c: The company's group has a single segment. The group consists of the company, a holding company, and 4 consolidated subsidiaries, providing system integration services and DX solution services. Net sales for the fiscal year ended November 2025 were ¥5,117 million.
